I'm new to VOAT, but follow the community for a while now. I see very interesting posts and feedback here from all you here, also in the gaming section.

I'm gaming since I can walk, grew up with NES/SNES/PS1/Xbox/PC and love every aspect of gaming: reading articles, wachting game events coverage, playing games on all platforms and all genres, Esports, speedruns, etc... you could say I have a broad interest in everything what has to do with gaming.

What I noticed in the last decade is that the gaming industry is maturing: Game developers become bigger and also Game Journalism with sites like IGN and Gamespot is huge these days. What I also started to notice is that not everything became better. I see more 10/10 reviews that I cannot agree with at all. It seems that bigger marketing budget means better grades in some cases. I also noticed that gameplay is sometimes becoming less relevant in the industry: less co-op, bad online community environments for multiplayer, skipping of single player story modes, launching games with bugs, very expensive expansion packages, etc...

So I started to miss something while playing games, while reading reviews and while visiting game websites. So I made the decision to start a website myself. Goal nr. 1 is to just have fun making it: I spend 6 months optimizing/coding the website and I think I am 1 month away of being done (you are never fully done, but at least the feel of the website will be done for now). So in the past few months I also slowly started to fill the site with articles and videos. So far, I will link to other websites for full articles and gradually I will write more myself and make video reports with team members on game events etc...

Besides the goal of having creative fun, I also want to create a place where gamers can feel at home: part of a community, with nice clear environment to watch videos in, or read news articles. A place where gamers can earn automated points for commenting, logging in, for friend requests, etc... A place where you can earn badges and increase in rank or use your points/tokens to buy exclusive bonus content for logged in users. Also, if you log in, you can see a 'submit vid' button in the header on the homepage: I really want the community to be involved and your name will clearly be mentioned if vids you send to me are placed on the homepage.

Furthermore I thought it was important to have clear categories and to make it easy to search on categories. Main categories like: ps4, nintendo switch, xbox one, pc, speedruns, Esports, unboxing, etc... hopefully visitors will appreciate this clear approach and easy search option. Last but not least: If I place reviews I will use grading/rating for gameplay, sounds and graphics seperately, because I think that is fun and more & more sites are stopping to rate/grade games. So I step in where others left ;)

If you have time, please have a look at the website and let me know your thoughts!
